description: 发散判据修正：过短片段丢弃而非连坐整组，修复『A 和 B 对比』不发散
anchor:
parts = [p.strip() for p in _SPLIT_RE.split(query) if p.strip()]
    parts = [p for p in parts if p.lower() not in _STOP]
    # 单片段或过短不发散
    if len(parts) < 2 or any(len(p) < 3 for p in parts):
        return [query]
patch:
parts = [p.strip() for p in _SPLIT_RE.split(query) if p.strip()]
    parts = [p for p in parts if len(p) >= 3 and p.lower() not in _STOP]
    # 有效片段 <2 不发散；过短片段直接丢弃而非连坐整组
    if len(parts) < 2:
        return [query]
